step1_analysis.circuit_type: Inverter buffers with dummy capacitive loads
step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of two independent CMOS inverters (N7->N3 and N6->N0) loaded with MOS capacitors, alongside isolated dummy MOS capacitor structures (on nodes N4 and N5). Given the SRAM context, it likely serves as a delay matching element, dummy bitline load, or timing generation stage for the sense amplifier.

paper_reference.title: An SRAM Using Output Prediction to Reduce BL-Switching Activity and Statistically-Gated SA for up to 1.9× Reduction in Energy/Access

propagation_delay.description: Average propagation delay of the inverters driving their respective MOS capacitive loads.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ (C_load * VDD) / (2 * I_on). The load is dominated by the MOS capacitor (W=5u, L=0.5u). C_ox ≈ 10fF/um² -> C_load ≈ 25fF. I_on for W=5u NMOS/PMOS is ~1-2mA. Delay ≈ (25fF * 1.8V) / 2mA ≈ 22ps. Adding parasitic drain capacitances, expect ~50-100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 typical drive current and MOS gate capacitance for the given W/L dimensions.

static_power.description: Leakage power of the circuit in steady state.

sky130_expected.calculation: Leakage current for W=5u devices is typically in the pA to nA range per device. Total leakage for the two inverters is ~10nA. Power = 1.8V * 10nA = 18nW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical subthreshold leakage for SKY130 standard Vth devices at room temperature.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the propagation delay of the two inverters and the static power consumption. High-value resistors are added to the isolated dummy capacitor nodes to prevent SPICE matrix singularity errors.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Inverters and Dummy Capacitors
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N3 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 N2 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 LABEL_NET_0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N5 LABEL_NET_3 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VN1 N1 0 0.9
VN2 N2 0 0.9

* Prevent floating nodes on isolated dummy capacitors
R_N4 N4 0 1G
R_N5 N5 0 1G

* Input Signals
VIN1 N7 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 4n)
VIN2 N6 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 4n)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* Transient Analysis for Delay
tran 10p 10n
meas tran tpd_fall_1 trig v(N7) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran tpd_rise_1 trig v(N7) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran tpd_fall_2 trig v(N6) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran tpd_rise_2 trig v(N6) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1

let avg_tpd_1 = (tpd_fall_1 + tpd_rise_1) / 2
let avg_tpd_2 = (tpd_fall_2 + tpd_rise_2) / 2
print avg_tpd_1 avg_tpd_2

* DC Operating Point for Static Power
op
let static_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print static_power

quit
.endc
.end
